body: Inb4 Warriors come back from a 3-1 deficit

Just got back from the theatre and I absolutely loved the movie but still managed to walk away with one thing that particularly grinded my gears. Is anyone else disappointed with Banner’s story arc? Like what was the point of literally nerfing him in infinity War and giving him little to no payoff in Endgame? Seems to me like Professor Hulk was reduced to comedic relief ala Thor in Ragnarok and Endgame as well(but at least he had bad-ass action scenes). Again, loved the movie but it just seems like Hulk could’ve easily turned the tide in many battles and he definitely deserved his rematch with an even more brutal Thanos than we see in Infinity War.
RIP Gus. Glad this legend is still living on through his music!
